_meta.description: The 20 combat stats of Sword x Staff with the game's English labels, from zeroluck.gg's combat stats page (read through WebFetch 2026-11-18). opposed_stat is the stat it works against; opposition_stated_by_source=false means the pairing is our inference from the names. null = not stated. No formulas or caps are published.

stats.name: HP
stats.effect: Health; set by class, raised by gear and Fantomons

stats.name: ATK
stats.effect: Base damage before crit, element and damage-boost multipliers

stats.name: DEF
stats.effect: Lowers damage taken

stats.name: SPD
stats.effect: Turn order and how often a unit acts

stats.name: Crit Rate
stats.effect: Chance to crit

stats.name: Crit DMG
stats.effect: Extra damage of a crit

stats.name: DMG Boost
stats.effect: Percentage increase to all damage dealt

stats.name: Effect Hit Rate
stats.effect: Chance that debuffs and status effects land (data name: Base Effect Hit Rate)

stats.name: PvP Bonus DMG
stats.effect: Extra damage against players

stats.name: PvE Bonus DMG
stats.effect: Extra damage against monsters

stats.name: Block Rate
stats.effect: Chance to block a hit and reduce its damage

stats.name: Block Efficiency
stats.effect: How much damage a block removes

stats.name: Crit RES
stats.effect: Lowers the enemy's chance to crit you

stats.name: DMG RES
stats.effect: Percentage reduction of all damage taken

stats.name: Resilience
stats.effect: Described as companion sturdiness against burst and control

stats.name: Effect RES
stats.effect: Resists debuffs and status effects (data name: Base Effect RES)

stats.name: PvP DMG RES
stats.effect: Less damage from players

stats.name: PvE DMG RES
stats.effect: Less damage from monsters

stats.name: Accuracy
stats.effect: Counters the enemy's Block Rate

stats.name: Healing Boost
stats.effect: Stronger heals; no icon in game
